people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.
translations.bsb: When David and his men came to the city, they found it burned down and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.
translations.kjv: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
translations.asv: And when David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captive.
